question.text: For a polynomial <math><mrow><mi>g</mi><mfenced><mi>x</mi></mfenced></mrow></math> with real coefficients, let <math><mrow><msub><mi>m</mi><mi>g</mi></msub></mrow></math> denote the number of distinct real roots of <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>g</mi><mfenced><mi>x</mi></mfenced></math>. Suppose <math><mi>S</mi></math> is the set of polynomials with real coefficients defined by <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>S</mi><mo>=</mo><mfenced close="}" open="{"><mrow><msup><mfenced><mrow><msup><mi>x</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>−</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow></mfenced><mn>2</mn></msup><mfenced><mrow><msub><mi>a</mi><mn>0</mn></msub><mo>+</mo><msub><mi>a</mi><mn>1</mn></msub><mi>x</mi><mo>+</mo><msub><mi>a</mi><mn>2</mn></msub><msup><mi>x</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>+</mo><msub><mi>a</mi><mn>3</mn></msub><msup><mi>x</mi><mn>3</mn></msup></mrow></mfenced><mo> </mo><mo>:</mo><msub><mi>a</mi><mn>0</mn></msub><mo>,</mo><mo> </mo><msub><mi>a</mi><mn>1</mn></msub><mo>,</mo><mo> </mo><msub><mi>a</mi><mn>2</mn></msub><mo>,</mo><mo> </mo><msub><mi>a</mi><mn>3</mn></msub><mo>∈</mo><mi>R</mi></mrow></mfenced></math>. For a polynomial <math><mi>f</mi></math>, let <math><mrow><mi>f</mi><mo>'</mo></mrow></math> and <math><msup><mi>f</mi><mo>″</mo></msup> </math> denote its first and second order derivatives respectively. Then the minimum possible value of <math><mrow><mfenced><mrow><msub><mi>m</mi><msup><mi>f</mi><mo>′</mo></msup> </msub><mo>+</mo><msub><mi>m</mi><msup><mi>f</mi><mo>″</mo></msup> </msub></mrow></mfenced></mrow></math>, where <math><mrow><mi>f</mi><mo>∈</mo><mi>S</mi></mrow></math>, is ____

solution.text:
fx is a polynomial in x such that fx=x2−12 a0+a1x+a2x2+a3x3 : a0, a1, a2, a3∈R

So, f'x=x2−1 qx where qx is polynomial roots of f′x=−1, 1

So, by Rolle’s theorem, f1=0=f−1⇒f'α=0, where α∈−1, 1

⇒ minimum mf′ =3

Again by Rolle’s theorem, at least one real root lies in −1, α and at least one real root lies in α, 1 of f″x

So, minimum mf″ =2
⇒ Minimum possible value of mf′ +mf″ =5
